scope: Reference-inspired stash and spatial equipment layout, retaining the OoT theme; 18 painted gem icons

build.final_link: CMake-generated soh/soh-macos link command emitted by ninja -t commands -s
build.note: Concurrent builds in the shared checkout repeatedly invalidated Ninja dependency metadata; final UI iterations compiled the changed object and used the generated link command.

art.asset_checks: 18 unique material IDs, RGBA transparency and SHA256 hashes verified against the manifest
visual_checks: All variants reviewed at 96px in color and 48px in grayscale.
Painted gem cards, grade selectors, material details and refinement input/output loaded in the native application.
art.theme: Original journal-stone artwork, indigo controls, native OoT glyphs and yellow pause-selection cursors retained.

native_checks: 1280x800: Stash and Inventory panels; Gear/Gems/Runes categories; sword and shield flank tunic and boots; bows and hammers sit below.
1280x800: all 18 gems and their names fit together, aligned by family and grade; switching stash categories leaves equipment visible.
Selecting a gem opens its artwork, quantity and slot-specific socket bonuses; Socket stone and Refine gem actions are visible together.
Refine gem preserves the chosen family and grade when entering the forge.
Rough Ruby refinement: 6 -> 3 -> 0; Cut Ruby 6 -> 8. Empty stack visibly dims and the transaction disables with a reason.
Selecting Sapphire updates all three grade-button paintings and the before/after conversion preview.
Rune stash remains available with all six native material IDs.
Click Equip in the inspector equips Cinderwake, returns displaced gear to the source backpack slot, and preserves the occupied-slot count.
640x480: compact Change page control expands all eight journal destinations and closes after selecting one.
640x480: full-width Stash and Equipment views; complete gem cards remain visible; material selection opens a separate readable inspector with socket/refine actions.
640x480: equipment view shows the four core armor/weapon slots at large scale; additional weapon slots and actions scroll below.
640x480 forge: large gem artwork and grade controls remain visible; scrolling reaches the refinement preview and combine button while action navigation stays fixed.
Adventure Items remains reachable through the compact chooser; Escape returns to Equipment.
Final reviewed preview restored to 1280x800, showing the gem stash alongside equipment.
isolation: Temporary SHIP_HOME profiles with SOH_ARPG_SANDBOX=1 and SOH_ARPG_FORGE_PREVIEW=1; no normal save files modified.
limits: Physical controller not attached or tested.

Native automation selected source cards instead of sustaining a drag, so drag-and-drop was not confirmed. Click-to-equip was verified; existing atomic move handlers are retained and active drag sources keep equipment targets visible.
